name: things
description: Send tasks to Things 3 through its URI scheme on macOS.

interface.longDescription: Local Things 3 integration for macOS: single tasks and batches, notes, dates, reminders, tags, checklists, and existing projects. A Things key is required and stored in private local configuration. Preview tasks without creating them. Uses Python 3.9+ and the standard library.
defaultPrompt: Add to Things: buy milk tomorrow.
Send this list of tasks to Things.
Prepare a Things task with a checklist.
